scope: Focused additional photo research for destinations 28, 30, 31, 35, 36 and 37; research candidates only

summary.notes: No candidate was added to the active catalog. Two unchanged publisher-provided mosque poster JPEGs were approved under Muslim.uz's conditional reuse grant after maintainer review. The Sulton Uvays panorama is shared-complex context only, not proof of Valiy Ota's individual mausoleum.

rejectedLeads.author: Oybarchin0302
rejectedLeads.visualInspection: Modern large blue-domed mosque, minaret, city buildings and a paved canal embankment at sunset. It is not an archaeological dingi/cemetery photograph.
rejectedLeads.decision: Reject for Qusxana despite its filename, uploader description and valid CC license. A filename alone is insufficient evidence of the pictured subject.

destinations.identity: Valiy Ota's separate mausoleum north of Sulton Uvays Bobo within the shared cemetery complex

candidates.author: Ashirbek14
candidates.visualInspection: Wide cemetery panorama with many graves and a distant domed shrine on the hill; no individual Valiy Ota identification is visible.
candidates.identityEvidence: Commons identifies the Sulton Uvays Bobo complex in Karakalpakstan. The national register independently places Valiy Ota's separate monument within that shared cemetery complex.
candidates.requiredCaption: Overview of the shared Sulton Uvays cemetery complex; Valiy Ota's individual mausoleum is not identified in this photograph.
candidates.decision: Reviewable contextual overview only. Do not relabel it as an exact photograph of Valiy Ota's separate shrine or duplicate destination 25's gallery to satisfy a photo count.

destinations.identity: Shayx Jalil Bobo mausoleum, Qoybaq, Qoraozak district

reviewedLeads.result: Current HTML has no subject photograph; its repeated property-gallery/1.jpg examples are commented-out template placeholders. Footer says All Rights Reserved.

Tourism Committee's 2026-02-06 multi-location visit report mentions the shrine. Two inspected gallery files showed a Chimbay handicraft center and riverside boats, not the shrine. They were discarded. Generic gallery captions and government hosting do not establish subject identity or photo reuse permission.

destinations.decision: Retain a placeholder. Do not substitute a similarly named shrine in Fergana, Pakistan or another region.

destinations.identity: Eshim Axun cemetery/shrine at Arzimbetqum, Qanlikol district

reviewedLeads.result: Names an Eshim Axun mosque on Amir Temur street in Qanlikol. It does not establish that mosque photographs depict the Arzimbetqum cemetery/shrine at the destination pin.
Local-government channel discusses a community meeting at the Eshim Axun congregational mosque. No exact cemetery photo or applicable reuse license was established.

destinations.decision: Retain a placeholder; do not silently replace the cemetery/shrine with a same-name congregational mosque.

methodNotes: The national register was fetched and its HTML inspected. It contains identity/coordinate text but no photographs of these six destinations.
Searches used Uzbek, Russian, Karakalpak and English aliases, including rural location names, plus exact Wikimedia Commons file searches.
Targeted British Library / Endangered Archives searches did not establish an exact photograph; a direct EAP query returned no usable response.
No government-wide or UNESCO-wide photo license was assumed. A National PR-Centre license was not applied to another publisher's domain.
Downloaded candidate JPEGs were visually inspected using local image reading. Application code, a server, browser and tests were not launched.

records.identityNote: Yusuf Eshon Bobo mosque in Mangit, Amudaryo district; distinct from the Yusuf Iyshan cemetery at Xojayli; exact publisher article titles and inspected poster photographs identify this mosque. The website footer permits reuse with author credit and its prescribed two links.
